text:
### Key Features  
- **Easy Access:** Withdraw funds at any time without notice period
- **Competitive Interest:** Variable interest rate, paid monthly
- **Joint Accounts:** Support for joint account holders (see [[business_ontology]])
- **Online Banking:** Full digital access via mobile and web
- **Branch Access:** Account opening and queries at any FirstUK branch (see [[branches]])
- **Standing Orders:** Set up regular transfers to other accounts
- **Direct Debits:** Automatic payment setup for bills and subscriptions
- **Debit Card:** Linked debit card for ATM withdrawals and online purchases
- **Mobile Banking:** Dedicated mobile app with biometric authentication

raw_entities.description: A variable interest rate applied to the savings account, paid on a monthly basis. The rate is described as competitive within the product offering.
context: Competitive Interest: Variable interest rate, paid monthly

raw_entities.description: A party with legal rights and obligations over a joint account arrangement. The savings account product explicitly supports multiple joint account holders.

raw_entities.description: A regular payment instruction capability available on the savings account, allowing customers to set up recurring transfers to other accounts.

raw_entities.description: An automatic payment setup feature on the savings account enabling customers to authorize recurring bill and subscription payments.

raw_entities.description: A payment card linked to the savings account, enabling customers to withdraw funds at ATMs and make online purchases.
context: Debit Card: Linked debit card for ATM withdrawals and online purchases

raw_entities.description: A dedicated mobile application providing digital access to the savings account with biometric authentication capabilities for secure customer authentication.

raw_entities.description: A digital banking platform providing full online access to the savings account via web and mobile channels.
context: Online Banking: Full digital access via mobile and web

raw_entities.name: FirstUK Branch Network
raw_entities.description: The physical branch locations of FirstUK Bank where customers can open savings accounts and make account-related queries.
context: Branch Access: Account opening and queries at any FirstUK branch
